g.text: Independent source review: seven recorded findings
F1: Duplicate rejection can overwrite prior receipt
v2 owned-output flags address source path
F2: Launch gap can leave worker executing after lease loss
v2 worker waits for short-lived ownership permit
F3: Admission can omit all four exact controls
v2 exact ordered list and critical recipe fields compared
F4: Live prefix may include bytes appended after fsync
v2 fixed length hashed then fsynced
F5: Positive ceiling accepts infinity and bool
v2 finite nonbool values and allocation receipt checked
F6: Concurrent atomic temporary deletion can abort size census
Known atomic-temp disappearance only is tolerated; other I/O errors fail
F7: Seal failure can leave previous terminal receipt marked passed
Pending receipt, sealed manifest and separate completion marker required
Source inspection only. No wrapper, compiler, unit or tests executed. [pcc:unverified]
